model.scad.name: Tall
model.scad.description: 1.5× body height, matching the upstream tall variant.

battery-organizer.scad.name: AAA
battery-organizer.scad.description: AAA cells. Smaller wells, more pockets.

generic-organizer.scad.name: 1x2
generic-organizer.scad.description: One row of two pockets. Long parts or pens.

generic-organizer.scad.name: 2x2
generic-organizer.scad.description: Four pockets. Matches the upstream 2×2 divider.

generic-organizer.scad.name: 2x3
generic-organizer.scad.description: Six pockets. Screws and small hardware.

bit-organizer.scad.name: 1/4 in short
bit-organizer.scad.description: 1/4 in hex bits, ~25 mm. Fits the default box height.

bit-organizer.scad.name: 1/4 in long
bit-organizer.scad.description: 1/4 in hex bits, ~50 mm. Tall box so the bits stay under the lip. A full tray should not take a box on top if bits sit proud.

sd-organizer.scad.name: SD
sd-organizer.scad.description: Full-size SD slots. Count follows the box footprint.

sd-organizer.scad.name: microSD
sd-organizer.scad.description: microSD (TF) slots. Count follows the box footprint.

sd-organizer.scad.name: Mixed
sd-organizer.scad.description: SD columns plus a microSD (TF) strip. Drops an SD column rather than growing the box.
